about: Untraced-handle shapes (fix/pine-host-untraced-handle-shapes; FIELD REGISTER STEP A's class sweep): a delete / setter on a field read off an expression is `object.<method>` by name, and an `object.set_*` setter reaches every family with that setter. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: a delete on a field read off an expression vanishes again (emitPostfix answers false)
a setter on a field read off an expression is not counted (delete only)
an `object.set_*` setter reaches no family again (C45 reads `object` as a family)
mutants.from: if (m) lostSetterName(m[1] === 'object' ? null : m[1], m[2], via, null)
